plugins.description: Christoffer Baadsgaard's Claude Code skills. triage turns unstructured input into well-formed issues in your tracker; design-doc drafts and reviews software design docs; nest supplies NestJS version knowledge the model cannot have and verifies generated code compiles; visual-design encodes the visual craft Claude skips unaided — OKLCH palettes, single emphasis, and an optical pass. agentic-security-review audits a skill, plugin, MCP server, or hook against the OWASP Agentic Skills Top 10 before install. application-security-review reviews your own application code against the OWASP frameworks that apply — ASVS 5.0, Top 10:2025, and the API Security Top 10 — with cheat-sheet remediation.
